[[File:Bomblet_Generator_XWM.png|thumb|right|250px|A Scrurg H-6 bomber equipped with a bomblet generator]]
A '''bomblet generator''' was capable of fashioning potent [[energy bomb]]s by drawing from the power of a [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]]. The original [[Scurrg H-6 Bomber/Legends|Scurrg H-6 bomber]] prototype was equipped with [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bombs]] that were released via two bomb chutes. However, after the modifications, the rather unstable bomblet generator could provide an infinite amount of bombs for the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot's]] destructive needs. This generator was totally modular, allowing its safe removal for use in other craft when necessary. The [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] had a bomblet generator installed on his ship, the [[Havoc (starfighter)|''Havoc'']].

The bomblet generator was also installed in certain configurations of the [[Unstable Terrain Artillery Transport/Legends|Unstable Terrain Artillery Transport]].<ref name="cvd">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref><ref name="db">[[Unstable Terrain Artillery Transport/Legends|Unstable Terrain Artillery Transport]] in the [[Databank (original)|Databank]]</ref>
